editorial.blurb: A no-frills Hong Kong dim sum institution in Chinatown where carts of freshly steamed dumplings and proper Cantonese cooking feel like stepping into a tea house from home.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive for dim sum service when the carts are rolling and uncles and aunties are settled in—the freshly steamed selections rotate through the room, and tea service is spot-on; cooked dishes don't start until 10:30 AM.
